answer.book: Single work: Johannes Jacobus Grynaeus, Hypomnemata in Habacuc prophetam (Basel, Oporinus, 1582), a Latin commentary with some Greek. It opens with a dedication and a prooemium, then prolegomena in six numbered sections, then three commentary chapters divided into numbered loci communes, and ends with paraphrases and verse versions of Psalm 37 and the printed table of loci.
